mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS task_total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 'NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_optimization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 'EXEMPT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exempted_count FROM learn_task_assignment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND scheduled_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT COALESCE(task.category_code, 'GENERAL') AS category_code, COUNT(*) AS task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN assignment.current_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count FROM learn_task_assignment assignment INNER JOIN learn_task task ON task.id = assignment.task_id WHERE assignment.student_id = #{studentId} AND assignment.scheduled_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY COALESCE(task.category_code, 'GENERAL') ORDER BY category_code
